reconstructed_captions.4: The final hammer blow is struck, and the metal piece glows red hot on the anvil.
reconstructed_captions.5: Using tongs, the person picks up the glowing hot metal piece.
reconstructed_captions.6: The tongs carry the hot metal piece towards a container of water.
reconstructed_captions.7: The glowing metal is about to be plunged into the water to cool.
reconstructed_captions.8: The hot metal is submerged in the water, causing steam to rise violently.
reconstructed_captions.9: A close-up shows bubbles and steam as the metal rapidly cools in the water.
reconstructed_captions.10: The metal piece, no longer glowing, rests at the bottom of the water.
reconstructed_captions.11: The tongs are lowered back into the water to retrieve the piece.
reconstructed_captions.12: The tongs securely grip the now-cooled metal piece underwater.
